requires: torch (CPU) and onnxruntime on the controller: the playbook and drivers are the training code

onnx.output: 15 logits; the runtime takes the argmax (0 = keep the play, 1..14 = switch to plays.CHOICES[a - 1])

win_rule: checkmate: every escape arc of the evader (18 arcs of 0.40 m) is blocked within 0.15 m by a pursuer body or by the tape (leaving the square is not a legal move), at least 3 pursuers have their box within that distance of the evader's box, held 1.0 s while the evader tries to move. The runtime does not judge wins; this is what it was trained for.

arena.note: 2.4384 m (8 ft) square, origin at the centre, +x right, +y up, yaw CCW from +x

actuation.throttle: throttle command in [-1, 1], + forward; firmware duty = |throttle| x `limit`. A full command must reach 2.68 m/s (sim duty 0.37). Zero throttle COASTS; the drivers brake by reverse.
actuation.steer: proportional steering target, fraction of max steer (30 deg), + left
actuation.trained_with: two-corner-camera emulator, half the episodes with a 0.1 s command delay
